{{Short description|none}}
{{main|2001–02 UEFA Champions League}}
The '''knockout stage of the 2001–02 UEFA Champions League''' began on 2 April 2002 and ended on 15 May 2002 with the final at [[Hampden Park]] in [[Glasgow]], Scotland.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co19/se2728/all-matches/ |title=Champions League 2001/2002 » Schedule |website=WorldFootball.net |access-date=9 January 2025}}</ref> Teams qualified via the [[2001–02 UEFA Champions League second group stage]].

All times are [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] ([[UTC+02:00|UTC+2]]), as listed by UEFA.

==Qualified teams==
The knockout staged involved the eight teams which qualified as winners and runners-up of each of the four groups in the [[2001–02 UEFA Champions League second group stage|second group stage]].

==Quarter-finals==

===Summary===
<section begin=QF />
The first legs were played on 2 and 3 April, and the second legs were played on 9 and 10 April 2002.
